test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the reported speech.**

She asked Aditi, “Where did you have lunch yesterday?”

options.text: She asked Aditi whether she was having lunch yesterday.
She asked Aditi where she was having lunch the previous day.
She asked Aditi if she had lunch yesterday.
She asked Aditi where she had lunch the previous day.

solution:
The correct answer is **"She asked Aditi where she had lunch the previous day."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:

 
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• Simple Past Tense changes to Past Perfect Tense.
 
• Remove the commas, question marks and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use 'that' in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb 'said/said to' is changed to asked, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the question mark in the sentence of Indirect speech.
 
• The question is changed to an assertive form and is simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
• Example:
 
 
• John said to me, "Where did you write?" (Direct speech)
 
• John asked me where he had written. (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• The word **"yesterday"** becomes **"the previous day"** in reported speech.
 
• The question word **"where"** remains the same in reported speech.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

The correct answer is ***She asked Aditi where she had lunch the previous day***.
